evidence: TiAlC ﬁlms were deposited by thermal ALD using TiCl4 and TEA as precursors on Beneq ALD tool TFS 200. TiCl4 was vaporized from liquid source container at room temperature and TEA was vaporized from heated hot source container. They were both introduced into ALD reactor chamber by N2 carrier gas. The pulse sequence was as follows; TiCl4 pulse, N2 purge, TEA pulse and N2 purge.
